content.text:
The observed pattern is fully indexed by the cubic perovskite BaEuO3 (mp-1183310, a = 4.437 Å), so it is the only phase I assign.

**Matching peaks.** Using the cubic d-spacing for a = 4.437 Å, the observed peaks line up with the expected reflections:

| Reflection | Calculated 2θ (°) | Observed 2θ (°) | Relative intensity |
|---|---|---|---|
| (110) | 28.4 | ≈28.4 | 100 |
| (200) | 40.6 | ≈40.6 | ≈32 |
| (211) | 50.3 | ≈50.3 | ≈68 |
| (220) | 58.8 | ≈58.8 | ≈19 |
| (310) | 66.6 | ≈66.5 | ≈19 |
| (222) | 73.9 | ≈73.9 | ≈11 |

**Missing reflections.** The (100) at 20.0° and the (111) at 35.0° are absent, and this is expected. For both, the structure factor is roughly f(Ba) − f(Eu) plus a small oxygen term. Ba and Eu scatter similarly, so these two reflections should be very weak.

**Other candidates.** No other candidate is needed; there are no unexplained peaks in the pattern.

{"present": ["mp-1183310"], "confidence": 0.9, "note": "All observed peaks index to cubic perovskite BaEuO3 with a≈4.44 Å, with (100)/(111) weak as expected from near-cancelling Ba/Eu scattering."}
